passages.title: Right to rectification
passages.passage_text:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 16: Right to rectification
The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller without undue delay the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her. Taking into account the purposes of the processing, the data subject shall have the right to have incomplete personal data completed, including by means of providing a supplementary statement.

passages.title: Right to object
passages.passage_text:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 21: Right to object
2. Where personal data are processed for direct marketing purposes, the data subject shall have the right to object at any time to processing of personal data concerning him or her for such marketing, which includes profiling to the extent that it is related to such direct marketing.

passages.title: Right to object
passages.passage_text:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 21: Right to object
3. Where the data subject objects to processing for direct marketing purposes, the personal data shall no longer be processed for such purposes.
passages.label: Irrelevant

relevance.reason: The legal passage discusses data protection and the right to object to direct marketing, which is unrelated to the business process of purchasing items, payment, delivery, or returns described in the process.
relevance.evidence_process: The user starts an order by logging in to their account. Then, the user simultaneously selects the items to purchase and sets a payment method. Afterward, the user either pays or completes an installment agreement. After selecting the items, the user chooses between multiple options for a free reward. Since the reward value depends on the purchase value, this step is done after selecting the items, but it is independent of the payment activities. Finally, the items are delivered. The user has the right to return items for exchange. Every time items are returned, a new delivery is made.

passages.title: Right of access by the data subject
passages.passage_text:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 15: Right of access by the data subject
3. The controller shall provide a copy of the personal data undergoing processing. For any further copies requested by the data subject, the controller may charge a reasonable fee based on administrative costs. Where the data subject makes the request by electronic means, and unless otherwise requested by the data subject, the information shall be provided in a commonly used electronic form.
